zh: Antigravity 桌面会话与历史消息接入本地存储直读，加载毫秒级响应，并聚合展示模型调用轮数、Token 用量与生成速度。
修复左侧对话列表在筛选或全部条目已展示时仍显示「展开更多」的问题，优化列表分页边界。
优化全局设置移动端导航与视口自适应，完善语音输入组件与浏览器侧栏交互支持。
en: Antigravity desktop conversations and transcripts load instantly via local storage with aggregated model calls, tokens, and generation speed metrics.
Fixed conversation list showing redundant 'Show more' button when all items or filtered items are already visible.
Improved mobile navigation and viewport adaptation for global settings, with enhanced voice input and browser sidebar interactions.
